note: Volt Black (#0F0F0F) on white (#FFFFFF) — 21:1. Must clear AAA for all body text.
Mid Gray (#808080) on white (#FFFFFF) — 3.9:1. Passes AA for large text (18pt+ or 14pt bold) only. Use color.text.secondary at body.sm (13pt) only on large-text elements.
Disabled state — WCAG 1.4.3 explicitly exempts text in disabled UI components from contrast requirements.

Dark green (#7D9220, green.700) on white (#FFFFFF) — actual 3.5:1. Passes AA for large text (18pt+ or 14pt bold) only. Design spec claimed 4.6:1 but computed value is 3.5:1 — design review recommended for small accent text. Do not substitute green.500 (1.36:1).
White (#FFFFFF) on Volt Black (#0F0F0F) — 21:1. Must clear AAA for inverse/dark-surface text.
Volt Black (#0F0F0F) on Electric Green (#C6FF2D) — 15.4:1. CTA button label on brand green background. Well above AA and AAA thresholds.
White (#FFFFFF) on Volt Black (#0F0F0F) — 21:1. Secondary CTA (dark background variant). Must clear AA.
